description: Engro Polymer & Chemicals Limited describes itself as Pakistan's only integrated producer of PVC resin and caustic soda. Alongside PVC it produces sodium hypochlorite, hydrochloric acid and hydrogen peroxide, producing ethylene dichloride and vinyl chloride monomer at its plant in the Port Qasim area of Karachi. Its PVC suspension resin is sold in several grades for different processing methods, and caustic soda is supplied both as a 50% liquid and as 99% flakes.
headOffice: 8th Floor, The Harbour Front Building, Marine Drive, Block 4, Clifton, Karachi, Pakistan
